name: Tailnet-free public Nexus resource-ledger auth for a cloud VM
target: Exercise the production warm-pool provider reader against the Nexus public resource-ledger route from a simulated cloud VM without tailnet membership or public network access.
inputs: one cloud host with an expiring machine token
public HTTPS and public HTTP requests
observations: HTTPS bearer request returns only the caller host's pool declaration
other host reads only its own declaration
public HTTP route returns 403 and provider URL validation rejects before fetch
request observations contain host, path, protocol and status without credential values
